classes.name: SystemCheckController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling system check related requests, initializing the view, and rendering the system check page with theme variables.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the controller; checks configuration to show or hide the system check screen and sets HTTP response status accordingly.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component and template for rendering the system check interface.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Prepares context data including theme variables and rendering the Twig template for the system check page.

methods.name: getDefaultThemeVariables
methods.description: Returns an array of CSS theme variables derived from predefined color values.
